list.title: Tournament draws
list.intro: Who got a lucky or unlucky draw in upcoming tournaments, from the players' ratings.
list.about: Draws are from Cup2000 and the players from the entry lists on badmintonportalen, as soon as the draw is published, with their ratings from the week before. Once a tournament is played, its page shows how the predictions turned out.
list.predictionsExplained: The favourite is the entry with the best chance of winning the event with the actual draw; if the chances are right, about as many favourites win as expected. “Luck showed in the results” compares each entry's result against a fair draw with its draw luck (in rounds, a regression through zero): near 1, a draw rated a round luckier gave about a round more.
list.correlation: Luck explains only a small part of a result (correlation {correlation}): most of it is how the matches go.
list.noUpcoming: No upcoming tournaments with a published draw.

predictions.title: How the predictions turned out
predictions.luckShowedTitle: Results minus the fair-draw expectation against luck, regression slope

page.cancelled: Not played. {reason}. The draw and its luck are as they were published.

summary.predictionsExplained: The favourite is the entry with the best chance of winning the event with the actual draw. “Luck showed in the results”: each entry's rounds minus its fair-draw expectation, against its luck (a regression through zero). Near 1, a draw rated a round luckier gave about a round more; near 0, the luck didn't show.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.simulation: How lucky each player's draw is, from their ratings at the end of the week before the tournament. Every event is played out {runs} times with each match decided by the players' win chances, once with the actual draw and once with a fair draw: the same players drawn again by the rules, the seeds placed where the rules put them and everyone else at random.
howItWorks.seeds: Seeds are by the official ranking{version}, the list valid the Wednesday after registration closed (a pair has the sum of its players' points; without points, no seed): 2, 4 from 16 entries, 8 from 32 and 16 from 64, and in groups at most one per group. Seed 1 goes to the top of the draw, seed 2 to the bottom, seeds 3–4 are drawn into the second and third quarters, 5–8 into the eighths without a seed. A seed the organiser placed differently, or left out, counts as luck. Classes without a ranking (such as U11) are seeded by rating.
howItWorks.rounds: Rounds is how far a player is expected to get: one round for getting out of the group and one for every knockout round after that (a bye counts too), and one more for winning. Luck is the rounds expected with the actual draw minus with a fair one.
howItWorks.placement: In the X classes everyone gets a final place, so luck there is in places: eight players or pairs in two groups of four, the top two to cross-over semi-finals, the third-placed playing for 5th and the fourth-placed for 7th.
howItWorks.noLuck: Events with a single group (everyone plays everyone) or just two players or pairs have no luck: they only show each player's chance of winning.

legend.outOfGroupText: The chance of finishing high enough in the group to reach the knockout.
legend.outOfGroupOnlyWinners: The chance of finishing high enough in the group to reach the knockout, which here means winning it.
legend.winsEventKnockout: The chance of winning the whole event (the final).
legend.winsEventGroup: The chance of winning the whole event (the group).
legend.winsText: The matches the player is expected to win in the group, out of {max}.
legend.placementText: The expected final place, 1 to {count}: the final decides 1st and 2nd, the losing semi-finalists share 3rd–4th (3.5 each), the third-placed in the groups play for 5th and 6th and the fourth-placed for 7th and 8th.
legend.roundsText: How many rounds the player is expected to get through, out of {max}: {steps}. A bye counts as a round got through, so a player with a bye starts one round ahead.
legend.luckPlacement: The placement with a fair draw minus with the actual draw (in brackets in each column): above zero, the draw helps; below, it hurts.
legend.luckRounds: Rounds with the actual draw minus with a fair draw (in brackets in each column): above zero, the draw helps; below, it hurts.
legend.luckWithdrawals: Players who withdrew (lost by walkover) count too: the numbers are with them out from then on, against a fair draw with the same withdrawals. A * marks luck that withdrawals changed (hover for the split).
legend.seedsByRating: No ranking list for the seeding here, so the fair draw seeds the {count} strongest by rating
legend.seedsByRanking: {count} by the official ranking{version}, placed by the rules in the fair draw
legend.seedsNone: None: nobody here has ranking points{version}, so the fair draw is all at random
legend.resultSingle: Matches won, and who won the group, and against the expectation with the actual draw (once any withdrawn players were out).
legend.resultPlacement: The final place, and against the expectation with the actual draw (once any withdrawn players were out).
legend.resultRounds: How far the player got, and against the expectation with the actual draw (once any withdrawn players were out).
